description: TfL describes the lane-rental network effective from 1 May 2021. The scheme targets sensitive locations and times to encourage roadworks outside disruptive periods and earlier completion. The source states coverage of 69 per cent of the Transport for London Road Network. The service path contains 2020, while the description specifies the 2021 effective scheme; both are preserved. The layer is a scheme boundary input, not observed roadwork delay or charging transactions. Coverage is Greater London. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service. Licence and cost: The item metadata does not state a reuse licence. Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides planning or policy-area inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the existing TfL 2023 PTAL grid.
